caption: •Black 2 (V)
game_text: May add 1 pilot. During your deploy phase, may ▲ one Pride Of The Empire. All Wings Report In and Organized Attack are canceled. While DS-61-2 piloting, immune to attrition < 5.
lore: TIE/ln assigned to pilot DS-61-2. Has 27 ‘flames’ on cockpit, one for each Rebel kill. Control yoke has a holo of Mithel’s young son, Rejlii.
